name: Textarea
description: A styled multi-line text input that extends the native HTML <textarea> element. Features a consistent design with rounded border, shadow, placeholder styling, focus ring, and responsive font sizing (base on mobile, sm on md+).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with default styles (min-h-[60px], w-full, rounded-md, border, bg-transparent, shadow-sm, focus-visible ring).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text displayed when the textarea is empty. Styled with muted-foreground color.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, the textarea cannot be edited. Applies cursor-not-allowed and opacity-50.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the textarea.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled default value of the textarea.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the textarea value changes.

props.name: rows
props.description: The number of visible text lines. Native HTML textarea attribute.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the textarea for form submission.

props.name: required
props.description: When true, the textarea must have a value before the owning form can be submitted.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: When true, the textarea value cannot be changed but can be focused and selected.

accessibility.keyboard: Standard textarea interaction. Tab moves focus to/from the textarea. Text can be entered and edited normally.
accessibility.aria: Native HTML textarea provides built-in accessibility. Use an associated <Label> with htmlFor for screen reader accessibility.
accessibility.notes: The textarea has a minimum height of 60px. It uses text-base on mobile for iOS zoom prevention and text-sm on md+ breakpoints.

examples.title: Textarea with Label

recommendations.description: El componente Textarea debe ir acompañado de una etiqueta (Label) para describir su propósito.
